description: Expander for BPM LFO and BPM LFO 2, going immediately to the right of one of them, or to the right of another PHASEX; it gives copies of that LFO's wave spread evenly around the cycle.

params.text: Sets how many equal parts the cycle is cut into, 3 to 12; that many outputs carry a copy of the wave, one per part.
Sets how much of the voltage at the PHASE DIV input changes the number of parts, from full inverted to full.
Rounds the number of parts down to a whole number; with it off the spacing slides smoothly between whole numbers. The light is lit while the rounding is on.

inputs.text: Voltage changing the number of parts the cycle is cut into, through its attenuverter.

outputs.text: A copy of the LFO's wave, shifted on by its own share of the cycle, the first shifted not at all; outputs past the phase division setting stay at their last value.

notes: the outputs follow the clock patched into the BPM LFO this is attached to; with no clock there, nothing moves.
